entries.purpose: Stand up a real daemon in ServerWebChat's real-daemon test leg; the hub's own daemons are spawned through ./bin/claude-web-chat, not created in-process. There is no root export: '.' would duplicate this entry.
csrfRefusal for the hub, and the portal in the hub's tests. The connector does not use it: it requires the shared lib/relay in-tree, which v1 does not export.
The one daemon HTTP client, for the hub's own daemons on the hub VM (Home, dashboards).
Render built panes and write the store of a dashboard daemon through the driver API (confirmed by contract 10, Q-10.9).

The route and frame tables the connector enforces per level (contract 04), read by the hub to explain a refusal and by its policy tests; once they land, the ring-entry allowlist the hub applies again before it stores (contract 11, C-11.18).
The redactor at the boundary contract 11 fixes, so the hub masks with the same rules the machine does.

Host-path masking of user-text summaries at the hub, with the chat's folder as root and the home its display implies (contract 11, C-11.8 and C-11.13), and in the hub's run of the same projection (C-11.18).
Strip control, bidi and invisible characters from user text before the hub shows or pushes it (contract 11).

The one version comparator, the version facts and the install.sh URL the compat message names, so the hub judges the window exactly as web-chat orders versions; the connector protocol constants once they land (C-12.20).
The per-chat hostname scheme the hub copies. parseHost is not public: its ID_RE takes 8 hex characters and returns null for a 26-character chat label.
Read the hub VM's own instance registry and phrase daemon and session skew the way the picker does.
Resolve claude-web-chat, claude-web-chat-mcp and claude-web-chat-hook to spawn them on the hub VM; the argv contract of connect is contract 06's.
Read the dependency's version, which the hub reports as hub.web_chat in compat.
